svg.title: Three Kingdoms piece lettering
svg.desc: Six fixed inscriptions in two lettering styles: FZLiShu-S01 / 方正隶书_GBK (Founder, clerical lettering), and TW-Kai 98.1 (數位發展部，CNS11643中文標準交換碼全字庫網站，https://www.cns11643.gov.tw; Government Open Data License v1.0, https://www.cns11643.gov.tw/pageView.jsp?ID=59). Document outlines only; no font program. Centered by exact ink bounds, longest ink dimension one. Set-specific fitting and weight are owned by three-player-pieces.mjs.
